# Method GetMultiLayerMaterialDocumentEnveloppeBitmap

#### GetMultiLayerMaterialDocumentEnveloppeBitmap(DocumentId, int, int)

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 19, 0, 0)]

```

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  DocumentId |  inDocumentId |  Identifier of the document  |  
 
|  int |  inWidth |  Bitmap width in pixels  |  
 
|  int |  inHeight |  Bitmap height in pixels  |
